title: Correct SRD feature level metadata and repeated-use naming
description:
Problem
Some emitted feature records have incorrect or misleading level metadata and names.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
Examples:
- feature:fighter:indomitable-three-uses has level 9 even though the name says three

LABELS: ingestion, rules, rules-pack

notes: Fix implemented and PR opened: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/179 (branch fix/srd-feature-levels-naming-eshyra-0m9.14). Root cause: unstitched wrapped progression-table cells.
